title: Complainte et Danse
identity: Yvan Markovitch’s Complainte et Danse is an alto saxophone and piano work, Leduc AL23637. A 2024 University of Music Münster festival program identifies saxophone and piano; NYPL’s older catalog record gives the composer variant “Ivan Markovitch” and a c.1966 Leduc imprint.

evidence.claim: Presto listing identifies Yvan Markovitch, alto saxophone and piano, Leduc AL23637, six pages.
A 2024 university festival program lists the work as performed by saxophone and piano, spelling the composer Yvan.
NYPL catalog notes Paris: A. Leduc, c.1966 and gives composer as Ivan Markovitch.

collection_flag: Recital-programmed work, performed in a university festival; no grade or difficulty level documented.
gaps: No matching saxophone recording was verified or auditioned.
Composer-name spelling varies between Yvan and Ivan across the indexed program and library catalog sources; exact relationship of the older imprint to the current Leduc edition is unresolved.
